title: narcissus juncifolius subsp. minutiflorus
intro: Narcissus juncifolius subsp. minutiflorus, commonly known as Dwarf Onion-flowered Narcissus, is a plant species within the Amaryllidaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties, which may help alleviate various health issues such as pain, infections, and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Onion-flowered Narcissus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids like galantamine and lycorine, that exhibit neuroprotective, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. Research suggests that the bioactive compounds in this plant may also have potential in treating neurodegenerative diseases and improving cognitive function.
